title: fix: replace deprecated alias with comptime
body:
## Summary
- Replace `alias CONNINFO = ...` with `comptime CONNINFO = ...` in `test_pg.mojo`
- `alias` for value constants is deprecated in Mojo 0.26; `comptime` is the correct form
